prompt: The image is rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, capturing the bustling energy of an airport gate. On the far left, a woman in a blue coat stands holding a boarding pass, her posture rigid with anticipation. Next to her, a small child in yellow boots tugs at her sleeve, creating a gentle tension between them. A silver suitcase rests on the floor beside the child, its wheels turned slightly inward. In the center foreground, an elderly man with a cane sits on a metal bench, his head bowed in rest. Beside him, a large black backpack leans against the bench leg, appearing heavy and worn. A teenager with headphones around their neck looks at a tablet screen, ignoring the surrounding chaos. To the right of the teenager, a barista in a green apron hands a paper cup to a businessman in a grey suit, who reaches out eagerly to take it. Behind this pair, a flight attendant in a navy uniform points toward the jetway entrance, directing the flow of passengers. A rolling luggage cart stands empty near the attendant, its metal frame catching the light. Further back, a couple shares a hug near the window, their silhouettes soft against the glass. A potted palm tree sits in the corner, its leaves sketched with loose, flowing lines. Above the gate area, a digital display board hangs from the ceiling, though its text is indistinct. A security guard with a badge on his chest stands near the rope barrier, watching the crowd. A lost teddy bear lies on the carpet near the guard's feet, forgotten by its owner. A janitor pushes a mop bucket across the polished floor, moving from right to left. A pigeon perches on the windowsill outside, visible through the glass pane. A newspaper lies folded on an empty seat near the center. There is no rain visible outside the windows. There is no food court signage in the background. There is no electronic kiosk in the immediate vicinity.
